body:
## Pull request overview

This PR unifies cost tracking across AI operations and creates a standardized chart type taxonomy shared by Dashboard and Report widgets.

**Changes:**
- Created standardized `TokenUsageSchema` and `AIOperationCostSchema` for unified AI cost tracking, integrating them into 6 AI protocols (conversation, orchestration, nlq, predictive, rag-pipeline, and cost itself)
- Created new `chart.zod.ts` with 27 chart types organized by purpose (comparison, trend, distribution, relationship, composition, performance, geo, advanced, tabular), replacing fragmented chart type definitions in Dashboard (27 types) and Report (7 types)
- Added 56 comprehensive tests (35 for cost tracking, 21 for chart taxonomy)

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 39 out of 39 changed files in this pull request and generated 6 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/ai/cost.zod.ts | Added `TokenUsageSchema` and `AIOperationCostSchema` for standardized cost tracking |
| packages/spec/src/ai/cost.test.ts | Added 35 tests for token usage and AI operation cost schemas |
| packages/spec/src/ai/conversation.zod.ts | Integrated unified `TokenUsageSchema` and added `cost` field to messages and sessions |
| packages/spec/src/ai/orchestration.zod.ts | Added `tokens` and `cost` fields to execution results |
| packages/spec/src/ai/nlq.zod.ts | Added cost tracking fields to NLQ response schema |
| packages/spec/src/ai/predictive.zod.ts | Added cost tracking fields to prediction results |
| packages/spec/src/ai/rag-pipeline.zod.ts | Added unified token/cost tracking with backward compatibility for deprecated `tokensUsed` |
| packages/spec/src/ui/chart.zod.ts | New file defining unified chart type taxonomy with 27 chart types |
| packages/spec/src/ui/chart.test.ts | Added 21 comprehensive tests for chart types and configurations |
| packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts | Removed inline chart type enum, now imports from `chart.zod.ts` |
| packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.test.ts | Updated tests to use unified chart types, removed tests for obsolete types |
| packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts | Extended `ChartConfigSchema` for report-specific chart configuration |
| packages/spec/src/ui/report.test.ts | Updated tests to validate new chart types |
| packages/spec/src/ui/index.ts | Added export for chart schemas |
| packages/spec/json-schema/** | Generated JSON schemas for new TypeScript schemas |
| content/docs/references/** | Updated documentation to reflect new schemas and chart types |
</details>

The new `tokens` and `cost` fields added to `NLQResponseSchema` lack test coverage. Consider adding tests to the nlq test file to validate these new fields, ensuring proper validation for the TokenUsageSchema structure and non-negative cost values.

The new `tokens` and `cost` fields added to `PredictionResultSchema` lack test coverage. Consider adding tests to the predictive test file to validate these new fields, especially for the case where predictions are AI-powered and include token usage and cost information.

The new `tokens` and `cost` fields added to `RAGQueryResponseSchema` lack test coverage. Consider adding tests to the rag-pipeline test file to validate these new fields. Also note that the deprecated `tokensUsed` field should have tests to ensure backward compatibility while guiding users to migrate to the new `tokens.total` field.

The new `cost` field added to `ConversationMessageSchema` lacks test coverage. The existing test file `conversation.test.ts` contains tests for the `tokens` field but does not validate the new `cost` field. Consider adding tests to ensure the cost field validates correctly with positive numbers, rejects negative values, and works properly when optional.

The new `totalTokens` and `totalCost` fields added to `ConversationSessionSchema` lack test coverage. The existing test file `conversation.test.ts` does not include validation tests for these new fields. Consider adding tests to ensure these fields work correctly, especially for validating that totalCost only accepts non-negative numbers and totalTokens follows the TokenUsageSchema structure.

The new `tokens` and `cost` fields added to `AIOrchestrationExecutionResultSchema` lack test coverage. Consider adding tests to the orchestration test file to validate these new fields, including checking that tokens follows the TokenUsageSchema structure and cost only accepts non-negative numbers.
